description: This file contains the implementation of Drupal hooks related to the Options module, including help text, configuration update handling, and restrictions on modifying list options with existing data.

classes.name: OptionsHooks
classes.description: Contains hook implementations for the Options module, including help display and configuration update restrictions.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the Options module on specific routes.

methods.name: fieldStorageConfigUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to field storage configuration, resetting static cache.

methods.name: fieldStorageConfigDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of field storage configuration, resetting static cache.

methods.name: fieldStorageConfigUpdateForbid
methods.description: Prevents updates to list fields that would remove allowed values when data exists.
